key_insight: Tahoe turns prompt optimization for Text-to-SQL into a reusable hint-learning system that converts debugging experience into structured syntax and semantic guidance.
engineering_relevance: This makes production Text-to-SQL more practical by improving dialect compliance and schema-aware reasoning without retraining the base model.
method: Collect compiler, execution, and user-feedback traces into a structured Hint Bank.
Distill failures into Syntax Hints for dialect rules and Semantic Hints for schema/user logic.
Use a Strategy Layer plus retrieval at inference to guide Logic Planning before SQL Synthesis.
evidence_signal: On 113 Spider 2.0-Snow-0212 examples with GPT-5.5, Tahoe improved pass rate from 61.95% to 79.42%, pass@4 from 72.57% to 87.61%, achieved 100% Snowflake syntax pass rate, and cut critic rounds from 2.79 to 0.12 per candidate.
watch_item: The deployment-time human-feedback update loop is not implemented yet, so the approach is validated mainly in the development-phase workflow.
paper_title: TAHOE: Text-to-SQL with Automated Hint Optimization from Experience
